courses.summary: 丹格特公開設施介紹將煉油、石化與物流視為整合平台；課程研究大型新設施的跨單元驗收邊界。本課依序分析整體產品質量帳、自用電與外部電力、原料與出貨節奏、單元交接證據、多單元投用的依賴，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Dangote describes an integrated refining, petrochemical and logistics platform; teaching examines cross-unit acceptance boundaries at a large new site. The course analyses site-wide product mass account, own-use and external electricity, feed and shipment cadence, evidence for unit handovers, dependencies among multiple unit start-ups, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
